name: rounding-order/slow-joins-the-multiplicative-chain
source: game: Hook.ModifyDamage (one decimal through the additive and multiplicative modifiers, the caps after, one int cast)
doc: 5 x 1.5 x 1.1 = 8.25 -> 8 (truncating before SLOW_POWER gave 7). Slow's multiplier counts the cards played this turn (SlowAmount), so the scenario plays them; an applied amount does not set it.

xfail_engines.old: old truncates the Vulnerable result to an int (5 x 1.5 = 7) before it applies Slow, so the hit is 7 where the game's one decimal chain gives 5 x 1.5 x 1.1 = 8.25, which truncates to 8 (fix/rounding-order 2935e9ff not landed).
xfail_engines.core2: old truncates the Vulnerable result to an int (5 x 1.5 = 7) before it applies Slow, so the hit is 7 where the game's one decimal chain gives 5 x 1.5 x 1.1 = 8.25, which truncates to 8 (fix/rounding-order 2935e9ff not landed). core2 runs old's rules until its family switch is on (migrated_families.json), so it fails the same way.
